'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Brian Billetta DS Hunt Down''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Billetta]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Vader's Scum. Brian Billetta, 2014 Worlds, 2010 form. Unread reserve lines: 11.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
